deal.product_description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra is a premium 47mm LTE Titanium smartwatch designed for both style and functionality. It features a circular display made with durable materials suitable for outdoor activities, providing GPS tracking, health monitoring, and custom apps for various needs. The robust design integrates a range of smart features including notifications, music control, and heart rate tracking, making it an ideal companion for fitness enthusiasts and tech-savvy users alike.

The Refurbished Unlocked Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max offers an impressive 256GB storage and a huge display, perfect for both media consumption and productivity. Enjoy advanced camera technology for stunning photos. This model is designed to provide a seamless user experience with 5G capabilities for faster downloads and streaming. Refurbished to high standards, it comes in various colors and can support all the latest apps from the App Store, accommodating any Apple enthusiast's needs.

Refurbished Samsung Galaxy Z Flip5 with 256GB storage in a choice of Graphite, Cream, or Mint. The clamshell foldable Android phone uses Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, a 6.7" Dynamic AMOLED 120Hz main display, a smaller external cover display, 8GB RAM, and dual rear cameras paired with a 10MP front camera. The listing includes a one-year Allstate warranty and free shipping.

Refurbished Apple iPhone 14 Pro with 256GB storage. This unlocked model offers flagship-class features including a high-resolution OLED display, Pro camera system capable of advanced photography and videography, and ample onboard storage for media and apps. The refurbishment includes a one-year Allstate warranty and free shipping, making it a cost-effective way to get a premium iPhone in near-original condition.

Certified refurbished Acer Swift Go 14 (model NX.KSMAA.001) is a 14-inch 1920x1200 IPS touchscreen laptop powered by an Intel Core Ultra 7 155H (Meteor Lake) 16-core processor, paired with 16GB RAM and a 1TB SSD. It runs Windows 11 Home, offers a compact touchscreen form factor for productivity and multimedia, and includes a 2-year Allstate warranty.

iSinbox 1800 ANSI 4K Smart Projector is a portable projector offering 1800 ANSI lumens brightness, native 4K support with HDR, built-in streaming apps, autofocus and keystone correction, WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and a 36W Dolby sound system for improved audio in home theater or outdoor viewing setups.

iSinbox 1200 ANSI AI Movin 2.0 4K Outdoor Projector is a portable outdoor-capable projector with 1200 ANSI lumens of brightness and native 4K support (HDR10+). It includes built-in streaming apps (Netflix, YouTube), Dolby Audio via Bluetooth 5.3, auto-focus and keystone correction, and an adjustable stand for easy setup in outdoor or backyard screening scenarios. The unit is designed for brightness and portability for outdoor movie nights.

iSinbox 1800 ANSI 4K Smart Projector offers 1800 ANSI lumens of brightness, built-in streaming apps, auto focus and keystone correction, a 36W Dolby sound system, and modern connectivity including Wi‑Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3. It targets home theater use with high brightness and integrated audio for a plug-and-play experience.

Samsung U8000FB 55" 4K HDR UHD Smart TV featuring a 3840 x 2160 (4K) resolution with HDR10+ support, Tizen OS smart platform with built-in voice assistants (Bixby & Alexa), and three HDMI inputs. The set is a slim 55-inch LED display that handles high-dynamic-range content and integrates with common smart-home ecosystems for streaming and device control. Model UN55U8000FBXZA provides a full-featured budget 4K TV option for living rooms or bedrooms.

Bridgestone Turanza QuietTrack All-Season tire in size 215/50R17 95V XL is a passenger all-season tire engineered for a quiet ride and long tread life. It features all-season traction for wet and dry conditions and an XL rating for extra load capacity, designed to suit everyday passenger cars seeking comfort and reliability. The tire is sold individually and includes free shipping.

Samsung Galaxy A16 5G (128GB) on Mint Mobile is a midrange Android smartphone with a 6.7" FHD+ Super AMOLED Infinity-U display, Exynos 1330 octa-core processor, Android 14, and 5,000mAh battery with 25W fast charging. It includes a 50MP main rear camera, additional 5MP and 2MP rear sensors, a 13MP front camera, dual Nano-SIM support, expandable storage up to 1.5TB via microSD, and 5G connectivity.

Certified Refurb Roborock Q7 Max+ is a robot vacuum and mop combo refurbished and sold with a 2-year Allstate warranty. It combines automated vacuuming and mopping functions in a single unit with smart navigation and app controls suitable for hands-off floor cleaning across mixed surfaces.

Xenponad 1080p Smart Projector (Model H7-Android) is a native 1080p Full HD projector with 4K decoding and a built-in Google TV operating system. It projects images from 30" to 300", supports ±40° auto keystone correction and image zoom, and integrates streaming apps and connectivity for a standalone home-theater experience.
